extracted.name: Amazing Garlic Chicken Livers
extracted.description: Chicken livers are sautéed in a dry skillet, then tossed with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt in this mild but tasty dish that's done in under 15 minutes.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound chicken livers - rinsed, trimmed, and patted dry
instruction_lines: Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add livers and sauté in the dry skillet until cooked through, 3 to 5 minutes. Gently stir in oil, lemon juice, and salt until livers are well coated. Remove from the heat and sprinkle with garlic.
